notes: Perfect claim overlap (C7, C83-C85, C105) regarding nucleotide exchange mechanism. LLM rates as UNCERTAIN citing need for biochemical validation of modeling-based proposals. Peer reviewers are more critical, rating UNSUPPORTED and stating the analysis 'provides little in the way of a molecular understanding of how this works.' Both question the evidence but peer review is more definitive in rejection.

Strong claim overlap (C39-C40, C109-C112) on cryo-EM technical methodology. Both agree the data collection and reconstruction procedures are sound. LLM notes appropriate sample sizes and resolutions; peer reviewers acknowledge technical specifications without challenge. Agreement on methodological rigor despite peer concerns about interpretation of results.

High claim overlap (C6, C54-C59) on RF1 conformational changes upon RF3 binding. LLM expresses uncertainty about precise angular measurements at 9.7Å resolution. Peer reviewers explicitly support these observations, stating the analysis 'identifies conformational changes in both RF1 and RF3' without questioning the structural details. Disagreement stems from different confidence thresholds for resolution-limited data.

Moderate claim overlap (C34, C49-C50, C53) on L12-CTD interactions with apo-RF3. Both rate as UNCERTAIN but for slightly different emphases. LLM questions whether alternative interpretations can be excluded at this resolution. Peer reviewers specifically raise concern about resolution artifacts when comparing 15Å vs 9Å maps. Both agree additional validation needed.

Moderate claim overlap (C68-C72, C78-C80) on mutagenesis and conservation analysis of RF1-RF3 interface. LLM rates UNCERTAIN citing lack of statistical analysis and replicates. Peer reviewers rate SUPPORTED, accepting the mutagenesis results without questioning them. Disagreement reflects different standards for quantitative rigor in functional validation.

Moderate claim overlap (C62-C67) on RF1-RF3 interface characterization via electrostatic complementarity. LLM questions whether specific residue identification is definitive at this resolution. Peer reviewers support the interface analysis and mutagenesis data. Disagreement on whether resolution limits confidence in molecular details.

Partial claim overlap (C4, C33, C88, C91) on identification of apo-RF3 in semi-open conformation. LLM rates SUPPORTED based on gel electrophoresis and cryo-EM density. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, expressing serious doubt about whether RF3 is truly apo, stating 'it is not clear that the complex formed is actually free of GDP.' Fundamental disagreement on nucleotide state verification.

Exact claim overlap (C8, C86-C87) on L12-mediated recruitment structural keys. Both rate UNCERTAIN. LLM notes plausibility but seeks biochemical validation. Peer reviewers' uncertainty stems from resolution concerns and nucleotide state ambiguity. Agreement that claims require stronger validation despite different specific concerns.

Partial claim overlap (C92-C95) on biochemical aspects of RF3 action cycle. LLM supports the structural characterization and cycle model. Peer reviewers express uncertainty about RF3•GDP binding to ribosome, noting 'the field has been unable to observe the binding of RF3:GDP to the ribosome using any method.' Disagreement on whether biochemical model is validated.

Minimal claim overlap (C5, C60) on conformational state identification. LLM supports the novel semi-open conformation identification. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, stating 'the manuscript does not make clear how these relate to nucleotide loading and release' and expressing concern about actual nucleotide state. Disagreement on confidence in conformational assignments.

Minimal claim overlap (C31-C32) on cryo-EM methodology aspects. LLM R1 covers broad methodology (C30-C32, C39-C40, C109-C112) rating SUPPORTED. Peer R1 focuses on nucleotide state concerns affecting interpretation. Only C31-C32 overlap; different scopes make direct comparison limited.

No direct claim overlap but both address complete RF3 action cycle model. LLM R8 covers C98-C108 on mechanistic model, rating UNCERTAIN due to inferred rather than observed steps. Peer R8 covers C18, C20, C89-C95 on biochemical model, rating UNCERTAIN about RF3•GDP binding. Both question cycle completeness but focus on different claim sets.

Minimal overlap (C33 only) between LLM R3 on RF1 conformational changes and Peer R1 on nucleotide state concerns. Both UNCERTAIN but addressing largely different claim sets with different rationales. Limited basis for meaningful concordance assessment.

Minimal overlap (C55 only) between LLM R4 on RF1-RF3 interface and Peer R3 on RF1 conformational changes. Different primary focus areas with opposite status ratings. Single shared claim insufficient for meaningful concordance comparison.
